landing.title: Legal intelligence, grounded in statute.
landing.subtitle: A retrieval-augmented system that cites the exact section of the exact Act — never invented. Drafts FIRs, analyses contracts, explains rights in your language.
landing.feature_qa_body: Every claim ties back to a retrieved section. No hallucinated case law.
landing.feature_strategy_body: Turn a dispute into a sequenced plan — phases, durations, costs, statutory hooks, and risks if skipped.
landing.feature_fir_body: Map an incident to BNS / IPC sections. Export a formal PDF in one click.
landing.feature_analyze_body: Upload a contract or notice. Extract clauses, score risk, recommend negotiation moves.
landing.feature_pipeline_body: Watch the system classify, retrieve, rerank and synthesise — every stage is shown.

chat.title: Legal Q&A
chat.subtitle: Ask in plain language. The system retrieves and reranks Indian Act sections, then synthesises a grounded answer. Ask follow-up questions to dig deeper.
chat.placeholder: e.g. What are the legal remedies if my employer withholds my final salary?
chat.no_chunks: No relevant sections retrieved. Try rephrasing or run ingest.py first.

fir.title: FIR Generator
fir.subtitle: Draft a formal First Information Report mapped to BNS / IPC sections.
fir.incident_placeholder: Describe what happened, in your own words. Include people involved, what was said or done, and any property affected.
fir.examples_label: Or start with one of these examples

errors.backend_down_body: The Python server doesn't seem to be running. Open the backend terminal and make sure it shows "Uvicorn running on :8000":

analyze.title: Document Analyzer
analyze.subtitle: Upload a contract, notice, or agreement. We extract text locally, ground the analysis in retrieved Indian law, and let you ask follow-up questions about the document.
analyze.drop: Drop a file here, or click to upload
analyze.supports: Supports .pdf (text or scanned), .txt, .md, .jpg, .jpeg, .png — scanned files are OCR-processed (max ~30,000 chars analysed)
analyze.concern_placeholder: e.g. Is the lock-in period clause enforceable?
analyze.followup_placeholder: e.g. Explain clause 7 in simpler terms; is the notice period reasonable?

strategy.title: Case Strategy
strategy.subtitle: Describe your situation; the system designs a phased legal action plan with timelines, cost estimates, statutory hooks per phase, critical deadlines, and evidence to preserve. Ask follow-up questions to refine the plan.
strategy.placeholder: Describe the dispute, what's at stake, what you've already tried, and what outcome you want.
